en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand, ornate stone bank building labeled "WASABANKEN" facing a circular public garden with flowerbeds and a central statue on a pedestal. The scene looks down a straight city street with tramlines and early 20th‑century urban buildings. Printed captions in Swedish and Finnish identify the building and the city, and handwritten greetings appear in the lower part of the card.
